propositions: BindingRepository must own and persist live, retired, rotation, and alert files as the sole authority, retaining exact byte-layout, serialization format (sorted/indented/trailing-newline), and unconditional save behavior without eager writes during construction.
Rotation persistence failure must leave the sidecar file unchanged, replace the live file with new bytes retaining the inline last_get_pass floor, and swallow the exception without raising.
After a rotation persistence failure, a subsequent save must write the retained inline floor to the rotation sidecar before attempting live replacement, achieving sidecar/live convergence.

Corrupt live JSON raises ValueError and preserves the file; corrupt retired JSON returns empty, preserves the file, and attempts best-effort deduped alerting that swallows failures without altering the successful state-file result.
Live tempfile/write/replace failure after successful rotation must leave live unchanged, retain any earlier successful sidecar/retired writes, clean the temp file, and raise the exception.
Retired tempfile/write/replace failure or live replacement failure during retirement must leave retired and live unchanged, clean temp files, and raise the exception.
